chapters.title: Q&A — how can an ordinary seed produce an extraordinary teacher

paragraphs.speaker: Brian Mendoza
paragraphs.text: So you were mentioning that — just because the teacher comes from my seeds doesn't mean that they cannot be somebody extraordinary, like a secret angel. But then, when I try to go back to my previous lives and to analyze what seeds did I plant to see this teacher now, then I really cannot see them as extraordinary, because they come from my ordinary seeds and ordinary doings. Then if I really cannot feel that — what should I do?

paragraphs.speaker: Brian Mendoza
paragraphs.text: Who can tell me the answer to that dilemma?

paragraphs.speaker: Max
paragraphs.text: He was my projection, but he… it's extraordinary. Right? So that's the answer. He is extraordinary, but he is also my projection.

paragraphs.speaker: Brian Mendoza
paragraphs.text: Could you repeat that? Well, Max is saying that it's like Geshe Michael — he looks extraordinary to me, because it's coming from my seeds. Okay, so — but the question is, why? If my seeds are ordinary, why do I see him as extraordinary? How could that even be possible?

paragraphs.speaker: Brian Mendoza
paragraphs.text: You had training this year — right? You should have the answer.
